title: AppLoadingIndicator.pulse — revert to AnimationController.repeat(reverse: true)
completion_summary: AppLoadingIndicator.pulse fixed - replaced TweenAnimationBuilder with AnimationController.repeat(reverse: true)
objective: Rewrite _PulseIndicator in lib/ui/core/widgets/feedback/app_loading_indicator.dart as a StatefulWidget that owns an AnimationController with vsync (SingleTickerProviderStateMixin) and calls repeat(reverse: true), driving a continuous 0.6 -> 1.0 -> 0.6 scale loop. Respect MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) by rendering a static dot.
description: The current implementation uses TweenAnimationBuilder<double> with a custom _SinePulseTween and a 2s duration. TweenAnimationBuilder animates from begin to end exactly once per tween instance — it has no built-in repeat. After 2 seconds the controller settles at the end of the sine curve (scale 1.0) and the pulse visually freezes. The fix replaces this with an AnimationController + repeat(reverse: true), which is the standard Flutter pattern for continuous looping animations. The static dot path (when disableAnimations is true) stays unchanged. _SinePulseTween is no longer needed and is deleted.

anchors: lines 1-9 — file header comment block (update the doc-comment that describes the pulse mechanism; the 'no AnimationController' line must be inverted)
lines 37-100 — AppLoadingIndicator class (DO NOT EDIT — public API surface)
lines 102-114 — _SinePulseTween (DELETE entirely; AnimationController handles the tween curve directly)

lines 116-167 — _PulseIndicator (REWRITE — convert from StatelessWidget to StatefulWidget with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin, own an AnimationController(vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1000)), call repeat(reverse: true) in initState, dispose() in dispose, and drive Transform.scale from controller.value mapped through Curves.easeInOut)

animation_spec.curve: Curves.easeInOut (applied per half-cycle via controller.value; the controller's repeat(reverse: true) gives a smooth ping-pong)
animation_spec.static_path: When MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations is true, skip the AnimationController entirely and render a SizedBox(width: size, height: size, child: DecoratedBox(decoration: BoxDecoration(color: color, shape: BoxShape.circle))). This matches the existing static branch at lines 134-143.

state_management.initState: _controller = AnimationController(vsync: this, duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1000)); _controller.repeat(reverse: true);
state_management.build: AnimatedBuilder(animation: _controller, builder: (context, child) { final scale = 0.6 + 0.4 * _controller.value; return Transform.scale(scale: scale, child: child); }, child: <static Circle>) — the static circle is hoisted into the child slot so AnimatedBuilder does not rebuild it on every tick.

acceptance_criteria: _PulseIndicator (formerly lines 116-167) is now a StatefulWidget subclass with State that mixes in SingleTickerProviderStateMixin
_PulseIndicatorState owns a private AnimationController field initialized in initState with duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1000) and vsync: this
_controller.repeat(reverse: true) is called exactly once in initState — no other place starts the controller
_controller.dispose() is called in dispose() — preventing ticker leaks
_SinePulseTween class (lines 102-114) is deleted from the file — no remaining references to it
dart:math import is removed if and only if it is no longer used elsewhere in the file (currently only _SinePulseTween uses math.sin / math.pi, so the import should be deleted)
The visible widget uses Transform.scale whose scale factor is 0.6 + 0.4 * _controller.value (or equivalent range 0.6 -> 1.0 -> 0.6)

When MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations is true, the static SizedBox + DecoratedBox circle is returned — the AnimationController is never constructed in that branch (gate the StatefulWidget's child construction so the ticker is only created when animations are enabled; the cleanest implementation is to keep the static branch as-is and only instantiate the stateful path inside the AnimatedBuilder's parent)
AppLoadingIndicator public class (lines 37-100) is unchanged: same constructor, same AppLoadingIndicator.circular factory, same AppLoadingIndicator.pulse factory, same named-parameter defaults
The 'pulse' variant routes through the rewritten _PulseIndicator in _buildIndicator (lines 86-100)
The file header doc comment no longer claims 'no AnimationController' — it now correctly states that AnimationController.repeat(reverse: true) is used for the pulse
All existing call sites under lib/ that use AppLoadingIndicator.pulse(...) still compile unchanged

grep_evidence: rg -n 'AnimationController' lib/ui/core/widgets/feedback/app_loading_indicator.dart must return matches in _PulseIndicatorState (initState / dispose)
rg -n 'repeat\(reverse: true\)' lib/ui/core/widgets/feedback/app_loading_indicator.dart must return exactly one match (inside initState)
validation.manual_visual_check: Render AppLoadingIndicator.pulse on a real device/emulator and confirm the dot scales continuously without freezing at scale 1.0 after 2 seconds. Toggle the system 'Remove animations' accessibility setting and confirm a static dot is shown.

no_op_outside_scope: Do not modify AppLoadingIndicator, AppLoadingIndicatorVariant, or the public factories. Do not introduce a MultiTickerProviderStateMixin (a single ticker suffices). Do not add new tokens or animation duration constants — the 1000ms value is acceptable inline or extracted to AppDurations only if AppDurations already exposes a matching token.
